docs: Idea from Midudev's scroll-driven animations demo (reel, 2026). Technical reference: MDN, CSS scroll-driven animations. Implementation is Retana UI's own; no code from the reel. Pure CSS with a local <style>: no JavaScript, no client boundary, safe in a Server Component. The animation sits inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) and @supports (animation-timeline: …), and animation-timeline comes after the animation shorthand. Without support or with reduced motion the content is visible and still. Pass motion="off" to hold it still from a toggle. Baseline 2026 newly available (27 Oct 2026): Chrome and Edge 115+, Safari 26+, Firefox 159+. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Loading and error are host states: the piece renders a skeleton or an alert. Ranges: entry 0% cover 40%, even cards entry 15% cover 45%. Keyframes animate translate and scale only; text stays at full opacity so it keeps AA contrast while it moves.
